probe.title: Your Page Title
probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Outkast ® Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast Menu Outkast ® Close Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast Front page of a national food section Kalvessa, specialty coffee roaster from Porto. Services Launches, Media relations Year 2026 Kalvessa launched its first retail blend in the busiest coffee week of the year. We built the launch around the roaster himself and placed the story on the front page of a national food section. The brief Kalvessa had roasted for cafés for six years and was about to sell its first blend in shops. The launch date was fixed by the retailer, and it fell in the one week of the year when every coffee brand in the country sends out samples. What we did We stopped pitching the coffee and started pitching the roaster. Teodoro tastes every bag before it leaves the building, and he has kept a notebook of every batch since the first one. We took that notebook, and Teodoro, to four food editors over two mornings, with nothing on the table but a cup and the pages. Samples went out after the meetings, not before, with a handwritten note from Teodoro on the batch each editor had tasted. What ran
